source.title: Definitions of Medicare Code Edits, ICD-10 MCE v44.0 (October 2026), FY2027 final rule

scope: The MCE edits inpatient (institutional) claims grouped to MS-DRGs. The age lists and the manifestation list describe the codes themselves and are commonly reused by outpatient and professional claim editors, but payers apply their own variants. The MCE sex conflict edit is deactivated as of 10/01/2024, so the MCE no longer publishes sex lists.

edits.title: External causes of morbidity codes as principal diagnosis

age_newborn.description: Age conflict: perinatal/newborn diagnoses, age 0 only

age_pediatric.description: Age conflict: pediatric diagnoses, age 0 through 17

age_maternity.description: Age conflict: maternity diagnoses, age 9 through 64

age_adult.description: Age conflict: adult diagnoses, age 15 through 124

unacceptable_principal.description: Unacceptable principal diagnosis (codes in requires_secondary are acceptable when a secondary diagnosis is present)

unspecified_with_laterality_available.description: Unspecified code: unspecified side when a right/left/bilateral code exists in the family
